thread:
sam: dropped two quick variants for tool-calling UI in the playground. Variant A: visible primary + two small inline secondary buttons. Variant B: single primary + 3-dot overflow drawer. thoughts?

maya: Variant A reads faster but may get noisy in run history. Variant B cleaner but increases clicks.

aria: accessibility: overflow must announce number of actions and trap focus. inline buttons need 44px target and aria-labels.

kevin: consistency with existing console: prefer single primary. also prefer label 'Invoke' for CTA.

maya: copy nit noted. proposing hybrid: primary visible + single small overflow for extras. adds discoverability and keeps density.

sam: hybrid sounds good. can we show a tiny badge when args present like '(3)' so users know there are args hidden?

aria: badge ok but ensure it has descriptive alt: '3 arguments'. and keyboard shortcut: K to jump to primary, Enter to invoke, Esc to close overflow. include in shortcuts overlay.

maya: plan: run a small A/B (hybrid vs overflow) with microcopy arms (Invoke vs Invoke with args). measure CTR, time-to-invoke, keyboard success. will post test plan Monday.

design-bot: poll started: hybrid, overflow-only, inline-all. React to vote.

sam: :thumbsup: hybrid

kevin: :point_right: overflow-only

aria: :white_check_mark: inline-all (a11y-first)

maya: thanks — will iterate mocks and include ARIA checklist.
